title: FOSS GREATEST HITZ — the open-source stack the NOIZY empire runs on
rules: Every link in the chain is FOSS unless listed under nonfoss, with a FOSS alternative named.
license = SPDX id of the code. Model weights get their own `weights` field — code and weights often differ.
install = how it lands on GOD (M2 Ultra): brew|cask|pip|npm|cargo|docker|manual.
usedBy = which NOIZY pieces depend on it (noizystdz, engr, noizybeast, empire, gabriel, lucy, demo).
verify = a command that proves it is present. scripts/foss --check runs them all.

tiers.core: Boot order. Without these nothing records.
tiers.ai: Local inference, STT, TTS, agents. Anthropic first for reasoning; local for anything touching the voice corpus.
tiers.empire: Self-hosted memory: git mirror, automation, sync, backup.
tiers.net: Sovereign transport: VPN, tunnel, relay, DNS.

nonfoss.name: Logic Pro
nonfoss.why: The DAW RSP already works in; ENGR drives it over MCU + key commands, FCPXML import.
nonfoss.exit: ENGR's FCPXML/MCU layer is DAW-agnostic; Ardour speaks both.

nonfoss.name: Audio Hijack + Loopback (Rogue Amoeba)
nonfoss.why: Per-app capture and routing with a GUI RSP can run one-handed.
nonfoss.exit: ROUTING.md documents the BlackHole-only route; Loopback is convenience, not dependency.

nonfoss.name: Talon Voice
nonfoss.why: Best-in-class hands-free computing; free beta, closed source.
nonfoss.exit: engr/talon.talon is plain grammar; the same verbs are ENGR CLI.

nonfoss.name: n8n
nonfoss.why: Sustainable Use License — fair-code, source-available, NOT OSI-approved. Fine for self-hosted personal/internal use.
nonfoss.exit: Workflows are JSON; the webhook contract in STACK.md is the stable surface.

nonfoss.name: Apple frameworks (HomeKit, ARKit, Speech, App Intents, CoreMIDI)
nonfoss.why: The platform. NoizyKit wraps them; nothing in the corpus depends on them.
nonfoss.fossAlternative: HAP-python / Homebridge, MediaPipe, whisper.cpp, Node-RED, RtMidi
nonfoss.exit: Every Swift module in engr/applekit has a Python twin.

nonfoss.name: Anthropic Claude API, Cloudflare edge, Infomaniak, Proton, TODAQ/Qatom
nonfoss.why: Services, not software. Chosen for sovereignty posture (Swiss/Canadian, open clients) — see empire/accounts.
nonfoss.fossAlternative: Ollama for reasoning on corpus data; Caddy + Headscale for edge; Forgejo for git.
nonfoss.exit: Open clients only (anthropic-sdk, cloudflared, rclone, Proton Bridge); no proprietary SDK in the pipeline.
